subject.measured_quantity: provider-reported token usage of an AI agent completing an accepted equivalent repository task
subject.interpretation: AIT and Git do not intrinsically consume model tokens; this protocol compares declared agent workflow surfaces.

executors.axis: executor is a pinned campaign axis; one campaign runs exactly one executor, and cross-executor results are reported side by side under their own campaigns, never pooled or paired
executors.shared_permission_scope: both executors declare the identical ait_benchmark_local_v1 filesystem scope recorded in the per-run codex-permission-profile.json artifact (legacy shared filename); Codex enforces it through its native permission profile, Claude through the workspace working directory, --add-dir roots, and the pinned tool allow/deny lists

codex.rejected_apply_patch_authority: rejected apply_patch attempts recorded by Codex stderr
codex.infrastructure_failure_signals: structured error events, turn.failed, error items, and candidate tool-process spawn failures

claude.program: claude CLI headless: --print --output-format stream-json --verbose --no-session-persistence --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "project" (workspace-scoped: loads exactly the benchmark-owned workspace CLAUDE.md and its empty .claude directory, never user-level settings), --prompt-suggestions false, --settings with the inline sandbox policy, --tools pinning the exact built-in tool availability surface; no --fallback-model is supplied
claude.version_pin: runtime.executor_version must exactly equal the measured claude --version output before any model request and is recorded in preflight plus publication evidence
claude.usage_authority: the single successful terminal result event plus its modelUsage inventory; normalized input_tokens = direct input plus cache_read plus cache_creation tokens so cached input remains a subset of input and provider_total = input plus output
claude.model_purity_authority: exactly one system init naming the pinned model and exact tool/MCP inventory, every assistant message naming the same pinned model, and exactly one terminal modelUsage entry whose key, canonicalModel, and token fields match the terminal usage object; any additional or different model fails the lane closed
claude.refusal_policy: a successful terminal result with stop_reason=refusal is valid provider-token-accounted functional model behavior, never executor infrastructure; it cannot be accepted equivalent and may consume the one prospective functional replacement only when the complete manifest declared that policy before execution
claude.feature_overrides: exactly the declared allowed-tool and disallowed-tool lists, prompt-suggestions:false, and the pinned CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 single-model environment, recorded verbatim as campaign feature-override evidence
claude.completed_file_change_authority: Edit or Write tool_use events whose tool_result completed without is_error
claude.rejected_apply_patch_authority: Edit or Write tool_use events whose tool_result reports is_error
claude.infrastructure_failure_signals: a terminal result event with a non-success subtype or is_error, structured stream error events, or a session that ends without any terminal result event; a successful refusal is explicitly excluded
claude.network_enforcement: bash sandbox enabled in strict mode (unsandboxed-command escape hatch disabled) with external network egress denied at the sandbox proxy and loopback binding allowed, matching disabled_except_loopback; verified by probe: external curl blocked, 127.0.0.1 listen permitted
claude.tool_surface_enforcement: availability pinned with --tools to exactly the allowed set, and the transcript validator fails the lane closed on any tool_use event outside that set
claude.filesystem_enforcement: sandbox filesystem writes scoped to the lane working directory plus exactly the declared additional workspace roots and Git write exceptions via sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite; verified by probe outside the tmp default-allow zone: listed roots writable including nested directory creation, unlisted external paths denied

product_boundary.core_sprint_mode: manifest-pinned off for the primary campaign; separately reported sprint-on smoke and complete campaigns are admitted
product_boundary.git_worktree_mode: manifest-pinned axis: agent_managed retains the historical measured lifecycle; codex_app_equivalent_managed starts the model inside a host-created detached linked worktree and records host closeout after the terminal model event without claiming Desktop private IPC

core.topology: one fresh single-agent session per run

modes.repository_surface: real local Git repository without .ait metadata; under agent_managed the measured session owns one linked task worktree, while codex_app_equivalent_managed starts the session inside an already-created detached linked worktree
modes.required_evidence: agent_managed requires the measured linked-worktree lifecycle; codex_app_equivalent_managed requires runner proof that the detached worktree existed before the model turn, no model-owned Git mutation, and separately timed host commit, fast-forward, and worktree removal after the terminal event
modes.metadata_isolation: each run owns a writable external Git directory connected to its fresh main worktree through a standard .git gitfile, plus one task path below an otherwise empty benchmark-owned writable worktree container; the narrow no-network shared executor permission scope reopens only the current run's protected Git pointer and resolved metadata, and no inherited GIT_DIR or GIT_WORK_TREE override is used

modes.repository_surface: current solo_local manifest-pinned AIT Task, Snapshot, and local Task-finish workflow; primary publication remains sprint-off while sprint-on complete campaigns are reported separately
modes.required_evidence: runner-admitted solo_local authority with the exact manifest sprint and edit-root-delivery modes plus measured task start, task finish, and task-relevant local AIT workflow commands; returned mode forbids --edit-root and follows task start's next_action command

sprint_card_smoke_diagnostic.admission: smoke scope, steady_state_task_cost, all five workloads exactly once in both modes, project_doc_max_bytes=0
sprint_card_smoke_diagnostic.ait_treatment: sprint mode on; exact run-scoped Markdown sprint card authoring, task start --from binding, task worktree execution, task finish, and automatic exact checklist closeout are measured
sprint_card_smoke_diagnostic.evidence: campaign and per-run sprint-mode pins plus exact sprint card path, item ref, and closed-item verification
sprint_card_smoke_diagnostic.claim_boundary: diagnostic only; never publication eligible and never pooled with sprint-off evidence

mode.repository_surface: one fresh AIT linear session with one benchmark-owned compact execution brief
mode.claim_boundary: benchmark context experiment; it does not change the current AIT product workflow

brief_constraints: derived from the shared task contract
contains no solution or file-location hint absent from shared inputs
generation cost is counted in first-use or precomputed symmetrically in steady-state

steady_state_task_cost.measurement_end: accepted local workflow closeout; for codex_app_equivalent_managed the model measurement ends at its terminal event and runner-owned Git closeout latency is retained separately

first_use_total_cost.repository_identity_policy: both modes pin benchmark-agent identity inside the fresh repository before the baseline revision

machine-readable input, event-log, observable-state, startup, and validation contracts

provider_usage.authority: provider-reported machine-readable session log or API response
provider_usage.claude_model_purity_policy: fail closed unless init model, every assistant model, and the sole terminal modelUsage key/canonicalModel equal the manifest model_id and the terminal modelUsage token fields equal the normalized terminal usage source
provider_usage.claude_refusal_accounting: retain a successful refusal as a protocol-valid unaccepted functional lane with every provider token included; never classify it as infrastructure
provider_usage.provider_session_failure_policy: retain a lane with any structured provider error event as infrastructure-invalid even when later commands, usage, or exit status appear successful
provider_usage.candidate_tool_process_spawn_failure_pol: a launch failure is measured candidate behavior when the same session recovers, exits zero without timeout, retains normalized provider usage, and produces a valid non-empty command transcript; count the failed invocation, retry, outputs, and all provider tokens. Otherwise retain the invalid run and stop immediately. Recognize both unified CreateProcess stderr and non-unified executor Io/exit-code-minus-one evidence

executor_preflight.topology: one fresh ephemeral session of the pinned campaign executor in an isolated temporary directory
executor_preflight.model_and_runtime_pin: exact campaign executor executable, model id and revision, reasoning effort, the shared ait_benchmark_local_v1 permission scope (Codex extends :workspace natively; Claude enforces the identical scope through its pinned tool policy), disabled command network, project-document limit, and default feature settings
git_worktree_permission_probe_commands: git worktree add on a temporary branch
git commit --allow-empty in the linked worktree
executor_preflight.git_worktree_permission_probe_accounting: runner admission without a model request; completes through the exact generated shared permission profile before the 30-command model executor probe and every candidate lane
executor_preflight.command_lifecycle_order: each command item must complete before the next command item starts
executor_preflight.token_accounting: record separately as admission overhead; never include in AIT or Git metrics
executor_preflight.failure_policy: preserve create-new preflight evidence, start zero candidate lanes, emit a stopped execution result, and require a new campaign identity after runtime recovery

primary_metrics.effective_tokens_per_accepted_task: sum(provider_total_tokens for every valid attempted run) / count(accepted equivalent outcomes)

mixed_workflow_metrics.pair_admission: exact common workload_id plus attempt with two protocol-valid summaries and normalized provider usage; workflow metric asymmetry never excludes the pair
mixed_workflow_metrics.reduction_formula: 100 * (1 - AIT / Git) when the Git baseline is positive
mixed_workflow_metrics.zero_git_baseline_encoding: null reduction with both raw mode values retained

fairness.project_document_loading: disabled symmetrically with project_doc_max_bytes=0; mode rules come only from the frozen measured prompt. The AIT-generated AGENTS.md is deleted after ait config set and its Plan archived through a runner-owned ait plan sync AGENTS.md --prune --local, and sprint-off also deletes the generated docs tree, so the measured AIT listing matches the Git listing and carries no exploration bait; sprint-on keeps docs because card authoring inside it is the measured treatment. The earlier stub-era claim that the file could not be deleted was wrong. No measured workspace in either mode carries project-document workflow guidance
fairness.measured_ait_treatment: accounting-profile-specific prose; steady-state contains only one local task start, returned worktree entry, project editing and validation, optional intermediate Snapshot, and one local task finish; every Git command is explicitly prohibited; local read-only AIT inspection remains informational and token-accounted but is not named, required, recommended, or forbidden by the measured prompt; environment admission is runner-owned outside model accounting
measured_ait_allowed_commands: read-only help introspection of the mode's own CLI (--help, -h, or a leading help subcommand): informational, exempt from lifecycle counts and surface checks, token cost measured; cross-tool help remains prohibited
read-only local inspection with ait status, ait diff, or ait blame: informational, exempt from lifecycle counts and surface checks, token cost measured; any remote authority remains prohibited

informational_cli_help_introspection.allowed: the mode's own repository CLI only, symmetrically for both executors
informational_cli_help_introspection.accounting: token cost stays in the measurement; the invocation is not a lifecycle step
informational_cli_help_introspection.cross_tool_policy: help of the other mode's CLI remains a mode-exclusion violation

symmetric_readonly_inspection.rationale: each measured mode retains its own native local read-only channel, but the benchmark must not coach either agent toward or away from inspection; natural command discovery and strategy are part of measured behavior
symmetric_readonly_inspection.accounting: token cost stays in the measurement; the invocation is not a lifecycle step and not a forbidden surface
symmetric_readonly_inspection.measured_prompt_policy: neither mode names, requires, or recommends any local read-only inspection command, and neither mode is required to inspect for its lane to be valid; both measured prompts carry one identical neutral sentence stating that local read-only inspection is neither required nor prohibited, so strategy is chosen naturally by the measured agent
symmetric_readonly_inspection.remote_authority_policy: never informational: any remote-carrying inspection remains a mode violation
symmetric_readonly_inspection.management_surface_policy: unchanged: task list, change list, task audit, queue summary, plan, workflow, and remote surfaces remain forbidden

fairness.measured_git_treatment: manifest-selected ownership: agent_managed retains the historical lifecycle charged to the model; codex_app_equivalent_managed has the runner create a detached linked worktree from the proven clean main HEAD before the first model event, starts the fresh Codex session there, forbids model-owned Git mutation or lifecycle operations, and records separately timed host commit, fast-forward, and removal after the terminal event; every AIT command is explicitly prohibited
fairness.cross_mode_repository_command_exclusion: mutually exclusive and fail-closed: AIT treatment prohibits every Git command, and Git treatment prohibits every AIT command

first-use: git worktree add -b benchmark-task <benchmark-owned-path> main
git commit (exactly one final candidate commit in steady state)

codex_app_equivalent_managed_git_contrac.model_commands: no Git mutation or lifecycle command; optional read-only local inspection is token-accounted and never required
codex_app_equivalent_managed_git_contrac.host_before_model: git worktree add --detach at the runner-proven clean main HEAD
codex_app_equivalent_managed_git_contrac.host_after_model: git add --all, exactly one candidate commit, git merge --ff-only by candidate object id, and git worktree remove
codex_app_equivalent_managed_git_contrac.evidence_boundary: managed-worktree-lifecycle.json and private host event logs explicitly record desktop_private_ipc_invoked=false; this is an observable App-equivalent boundary, not a claim that Codex Desktop IPC ran

codex_app_equivalent_managed_ait_contrac.task_start: the measured command omits --edit-root and the measured agent enters the physical edit_root through task start's returned next_action command
codex_app_equivalent_managed_ait_contrac.runner_boundary: the runner creates no benchmark-owned AIT task-worktree path and grants only the AIT-configured ephemeral worktree root
codex_app_equivalent_managed_ait_contrac.interpretation: this is a requested default-product-flow comparison; AIT is charged for consuming and following its returned worktree navigation while the Git lane begins inside the host-prepared worktree

git_worktree_start_point_admission.explicit_main: always admitted when the remaining declared worktree lifecycle matches
git_worktree_start_point_admission.implicit_head: admitted only in steady-state when git-start-state-proof.json was captured before the provider turn and proves an empty porcelain status, symbolic main, and HEAD equal to refs/heads/main; the declared worktree path must be the final positional argument, so no alternate commit-ish is present; closeout must additionally prove that ORIG_HEAD and the candidate commit parent both equal the recorded start HEAD
git_worktree_start_point_admission.first_use: implicit HEAD is rejected because repository creation occurs inside the measured provider turn and no runner-owned start proof exists
git_worktree_start_point_admission.predecessor_evidence: protocol .27 continuation retains its frozen proof-backed implicit-main treatment; protocol .26 retains its frozen literal-main classification and is never reinterpreted by this successor rule

fairness.git_metadata_layout: normal per-run separate Git directory connected through a standard .git gitfile; the metadata directory and an empty worktree container are additional roots of the ait_benchmark_local_v1 profile, while exact write exceptions reopen only the main .git pointer, resolved metadata, and task-worktree .git pointer; the task child is deletable without exposing sibling evidence and commands discover metadata after cd without inherited GIT_DIR or GIT_WORK_TREE
fairness.git_metadata_override_admission: reject GIT_DIR or GIT_WORK_TREE assignments applied to Git, persistent shell exports of either variable, and global git --git-dir/--work-tree options before the subcommand; admit read-only subcommand query options such as git rev-parse --git-dir

permission_profile.name: ait_benchmark_local_v1
permission_profile.git_write_exception_scope: agent_managed uses the current run main .git pointer, resolved external metadata, and linked-task .git pointer; codex_app_equivalent_managed excludes the inaccessible parent-main .git pointer and retains only metadata plus the linked-task .git pointer needed for optional read-only inspection
permission_profile.executor_enforcement: Codex enforces the profile natively; Claude enforces the identical declared scope through workspace working directory, --add-dir roots, and the pinned tool allow/deny lists

complete_campaign.revision_note: .48 retains the five-workload, two-mode, twenty-attempt 200-session matrix, separately reported sprint-on treatment, and the .47 manifest-pinned Git worktree-ownership axis, while narrowing the managed Codex permission surface; campaigns using different ownership values are reported separately and cannot be compared as the same treatment

codex_app_equivalent_managed_prefix_gate.scope: the first five complete adjacent randomized pairs of one frozen complete campaign
codex_app_equivalent_managed_prefix_gate.continuation: --max-pairs 5 executes schedule positions 1 through 10; a later resume executes only the unchanged suffix toward 200 sessions
codex_app_equivalent_managed_prefix_gate.admission_gate: all ten summaries form the exact schedule prefix, both modes carry terminal model-state evidence, every AIT task start omits --edit-root, every managed Git lane has closed host lifecycle proof, and no model-owned Git mutation occurred
codex_app_equivalent_managed_prefix_gate.non_gate: token direction, elapsed direction, or relative mode ranking never selects continuation

fable_max_smoke_gate.runtime_version_policy: smoke and complete manifests declare exact executor, AIT, Git, Node, and browser --version outputs; every declared pin is checked before any model request
fable_max_smoke_gate.admission_gate: all five adjacent Git/AIT pairs complete with exact model/tool purity, normalized usage, protocol-valid transcripts, ordinary evaluator/browser evidence, and clean workflow closeout
fable_max_smoke_gate.non_gate: token savings direction, elapsed direction, or relative Git/AIT ranking cannot stop or alter the complete campaign

diagnostic_scope.purpose: bounded single-purpose evidence that isolates one mechanism or measures within-cell variance

sampling.aggregate_method: median of paired workload and run ratios

atomic_pair_schedule.pair_order: randomize workload pairs inside each block, then randomize Git/AIT order inside each adjacent pair
atomic_pair_schedule.slice_unit: --max-pairs counts complete adjacent Git/AIT pairs; --max-runs is retired
atomic_pair_schedule.candidate_defect_policy: retain a protocol-valid unaccepted candidate as a measured outcome, finish the counterpart when safe, and continue the exact suffix without retry; after the complete matrix only a manifest that prospectively declared first_valid_unaccepted_lane_once may replace the first such lane exactly once in the same mode. An invalid attempt stops after its completed pair and an infrastructure failure stops immediately

immutable_resume.scope: a stopped admitted predecessor may resume only when its existing run IDs are an exact frozen-schedule prefix and the controller explicitly admits that predecessor; .32 additionally permits the .33 whole-pair infrastructure recovery contract, the exact .34 host-shutdown recovery layered after it, and the exact .35 digest-linked recovered-spawn correction before completing only its missing paired lane; legacy .20 retains only its narrow .21-adjudicator path
immutable_resume.existing_run_policy: never recreate, overwrite, or retry an existing run ID; execute only the missing schedule suffix with identical pinned tool versions
immutable_resume.valid_unaccepted_outcome_policy: retain every valid unaccepted prefix run as measured evidence and continue only the missing suffix; it remains acceptance-penalized. The sole exception is a complete .37 manifest that declared first_valid_unaccepted_lane_once before execution, which may append one same-mode replacement for the first valid unaccepted lane after preserving the source failure
immutable_resume.validator_adjudication_policy: append-only and digest-linked to the immutable raw summary. Legacy .21 remains limited to the exact read-only git rev-parse --git-dir false positive. The .35 correction is limited to the exact named .32 campaign/run/digest and clears only its obsolete infrastructure classification after proving zero exit, no timeout, usage, valid non-empty transcript, successful command recovery, terminal turn, and normal evaluation; all measured token and outcome fields remain unchanged
immutable_resume.derived_report_policy: archive each replaced derived report by content digest before atomically publishing the refreshed effective view
immutable_resume.resume_audit_policy: record each resume start and result append-only under a monotonically numbered resumptions directory with source and controller protocol revisions, continuation policy, runner path, and runner SHA-256

infrastructure_pair_recovery.authorization: repository-owner-authorized transparent recovery of one recognized executor infrastructure failure
recognized_failure_classes: provider session failure before candidate execution
infrastructure_pair_recovery.pair_policy: exclude every observed lane in the contaminated adjacent Git/AIT pair and re-execute both frozen lanes exactly once; never retain an unaffected source counterpart against a replacement lane
infrastructure_pair_recovery.execution_limit: one recognized executor-infrastructure pair and one two-lane replacement attempt per campaign; no second executor-infrastructure recovery, repair, or retry is admitted; the exact externally evidenced .34 host-shutdown path is a separate bounded contract
infrastructure_pair_recovery.non_retryable_outcomes: functional defects, evaluator rejection, browser failure, workflow failure, high token use, unfavorable savings, and model strategy are measured outcomes and never authorize recovery
infrastructure_pair_recovery.pin_equivalence: frozen campaign manifest, schedule axes, fixture manifest, prompts, model and reasoning effort, executor version, tool and permission policy, cache class, network policy, and recovery-runner digest
infrastructure_pair_recovery.admission: both replacement lanes must be protocol-valid, evaluator-accepted, browser-passed, workflow-closed, infrastructure-clean, and carry valid transcript plus normalized provider usage; otherwise the campaign remains stopped
infrastructure_pair_recovery.history: preserve every original source artifact append-only, checksum all observed contaminated source summaries, checksum both replacement summaries and the recovery runner, and publish the excluded evidence separately
infrastructure_pair_recovery.statistical_view: replace only the exact contaminated schedule pair in the effective view; complete evidence contains 200 admitted sessions plus one or two excluded observed source lanes and two replacement sessions
infrastructure_pair_recovery.claim_policy: effective claim eligibility may be true only when the recovered 200-session matrix satisfies every ordinary acceptance, provenance, and positive-statistics gate
infrastructure_pair_recovery.disclosure: publish the failure class, source pair identity, observed source run IDs, replacement run IDs, executed/admitted/excluded counts, policy revision, reason, and provenance digests

host_shutdown_pair_recovery.authorization: repository-owner-authorized exact recovery of the 2026-08-29 host shutdown after the previously admitted .33 infrastructure recovery
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.pair_policy: inventory and checksum the incomplete lane byte-for-byte, exclude it from statistics, and re-execute both frozen GD-05 attempt 9 lanes exactly once under distinct recovery run IDs
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.admission_evidence: the interrupted run directory exists without provider usage, acceptance, browser, workflow, or run-summary evidence; its nonempty Codex event stream has no terminal provider event; its final mtime lies in the recorded 2026-08-29 02:14 Asia/Taipei shutdown minute; last(1) records shutdown at 02:14 and reboot at 02:19; kern.boottime records epoch 1787941172
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.execution_limit: this exact campaign, pair, interrupted lane, shutdown, and one two-lane replacement attempt only; no generic second recovery or retry is admitted
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.pin_equivalence: frozen campaign manifest, schedule axes and order, fixture manifest, prompts, model and reasoning effort, pinned executor executable, AIT executable, tool and permission policy, cache class, network policy, and recovery-runner digest
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.replacement_outcome_policy: both replacement lanes must be protocol-valid and infrastructure-clean; valid functional, evaluator, browser, or workflow failures remain measured outcomes and do not authorize retry
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.history: preserve the entire interrupted directory in place, record a sorted regular-file inventory with byte sizes and SHA-256 digests, checksum the raw event stream, host observation, both replacement summaries, and exact recovery runner, and never materialize the missing source counterpart
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.statistical_view: apply the .33 infrastructure replacement first, then replace the missing GD-05 attempt 9 pair with the two .34 recovery summaries and continue only the unchanged frozen suffix; the final effective view contains exactly 200 admitted sessions
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.claim_policy: effective claim eligibility may be true only when the combined recovery view satisfies the ordinary 200-session acceptance, provenance, and positive-statistics gates
host_shutdown_pair_recovery.disclosure: publish the interrupted lane identity, event and inventory provenance, host observation digest, source pair identity, replacement run IDs, executed/admitted/excluded counts, policy revision, reason, and runner digest

recovered_spawn_adjudication.authorization: repository-owner-authorized exact semantic correction after the .33 infrastructure and .34 host-shutdown recoveries
recovered_spawn_adjudication.admission: the immutable source summary records only codex_tool_process_spawn_failure as invalid, but the same session exited zero without timeout, retained normalized usage and a valid non-empty transcript, recovered with successful commands, emitted a terminal completed turn, and reached normal candidate evaluation
recovered_spawn_adjudication.statistical_view: clear only the obsolete infrastructure failure and invalid reason in the digest-linked effective summary, derive validity and functional acceptance from stored facts, count every original provider token, execute no replacement, and continue first with only the missing paired AIT lane before the unchanged frozen suffix
recovered_spawn_adjudication.history: preserve the raw run summary and every raw artifact byte-for-byte, append exactly one adjudication file, and publish both the raw failure class and source-summary digest
recovered_spawn_adjudication.non_retryable_outcomes: functional result, evaluator result, browser result, workflow result, high token use, unfavorable savings, and model strategy never authorize this correction or any retry
recovered_spawn_adjudication.execution_limit: this exact campaign, run ID, source protocol, source-summary SHA-256, and one adjudication only; every near miss fails closed

statistical_replacement.source_selection: the first protocol-valid unaccepted lane in frozen schedule order after the complete source matrix; symmetric across Git and AIT
statistical_replacement.replacement_run_id: the exact source run ID plus -replacement-01
statistical_replacement.execution_limit: exactly one new same-mode session across the campaign; smoke cannot replace, and no second replacement, repair, activation, or retry is admitted even when the replacement fails
